description: Hand-written layout-probe capture matrix hunting clipping candidates across a wider theme/scale/viewport grid than the single pinned tuple each design/parity-inventory.json row carries. See doc/development/design_parity_capture.md.

languageModes.reason: This Rails application has no runtime language-mode switch (no persisted English/Cantonese/bilingual selector exists on any surface at this commit), so this matrix does not enumerate language-mode rows. Recorded once here, rather than silently omitted, per the project-wide rule that a genuine non-applicability is stated rather than left as a silent gap.
